---
title: Squad Current-State Baseline
description: "Template capturing how a squad delivers today before introducing Agentic PDLC"
---

Complete before introducing Agentic PDLC (playbook section 2.3). Capture how work actually moves
today, not how the process is documented. Store as `docs/discovery/squad-baseline.md`.

| Squad / product | Prepared by | Date | Reviewed with |
|-----------------|-------------|------|---------------|
|                 |             |      |               |

## 1. Delivery approach

Agile, Waterfall or hybrid; ceremonies, stages and approval points used in practice; how
consistently the stated methodology is followed.

## 2. Project and change types

Types of work typically delivered (greenfield, enhancements, regulatory changes, modernisation,
integration), their frequency and typical size.

## 3. Current SDLC / PDLC

How work flows from idea or request through requirements, design, backlog, planning,
implementation, testing, release and operations. Key hand-offs and dependencies.

```text
Demand -> ... -> Production
```

## 4. Roles and ways of working

| Activity | Who performs | Who reviews / approves | Specialist input | Where work waits |
|----------|--------------|------------------------|------------------|------------------|
|          |              |                        |                  |                  |

## 5. Tools and workflow

| Concern              | System | How information moves to the next tool |
|----------------------|--------|----------------------------------------|
| Requirements         |        |                                        |
| Backlog              |        |                                        |
| Source code          |        |                                        |
| Testing              |        |                                        |
| CI/CD                |        |                                        |
| Approvals            |        |                                        |
| Operational work     |        |                                        |

## 6. Documentation and source of truth

Where requirements, decisions, designs, standards, user stories and technical documentation are
maintained (Jira, Confluence, repositories, other), and whether the agreed source of truth is used.

## 7. Existing artefacts and context

| Artefact | Owner | Current? | Usable by agents? | Location |
|----------|-------|----------|-------------------|----------|
|          |       |          |                   |          |

## 8. Pain points and constraints

Delays, rework, duplication, unclear requirements, fragmented context, manual effort, repeated
hand-offs, quality issues.

## 9. Team needs

Better context, clearer specifications, tooling or integration, faster feedback, less manual
work, stronger review and governance support.

## 10. Current performance

| Measure                | Current value | Source | Period |
|------------------------|---------------|--------|--------|
| Lead time              |               |        |        |
| Cycle time             |               |        |        |
| Quality (defects)      |               |        |        |
| Rework                 |               |        |        |
| Other flow measures    |               |        |        |

## Summary

Concise current-state baseline: where agents could add value, what context needs strengthening,
which practices to retain, and how improvement will be demonstrated.
